summary: useDraft now requires the authenticated user ID and section key; unscoped legacy keys are never read or migrated, and signed-out sections do not read or write drafts.
Hydration callbacks and debounce timers are invalidated on UID or section-key changes; clear waits for in-flight writes, cancels the same key's pending timer, and prevents same-value rearming.
Basics and Hours local section state is owner-bound, and stale owner save/mutation callbacks cannot complete after an identity change.
A successful Hours save clears only its unchanged authenticated user's section draft; failed saves retain it.
Basics and Hours draft payloads exclude payout, PAN, and bank fields. Isolation is unconditional with Oorva switches OFF.
No SQL functions, migrations, feature flags, financial records, storage services, or packages were added or changed.

commands.command: origin/main:scripts/cs-test.ps1 sourced with git show and evaluated in-memory; -Suite app -Filter 'src.features.providerOnboarding.__tests__.draftIdentity[.]test[.]ts$' (GH_TOKEN set in the same process; snapshot index kept in the repository)
selectedCases: ID-DRAFT-A-B restores each authenticated account only from its own section key
ID-DRAFT-UID-RACE ignores stale hydration and cancels pending timers on identity or section changes
ID-DRAFT-LEGACY-IGNORE never reads unscoped keys or hydrates or persists while signed out
ID-DRAFT-UID-BASICS resets unsaved Basics values when the authenticated owner changes
ID-DRAFT-UID-HOURS resets unsaved Hours values and rejects a stale owner save
ID-DRAFT-SAVE-FAIL retains the Hours draft when the server save fails
ID-DRAFT-SAVE-OWN clears only the authenticated user Hours draft after a successful save
ID-DRAFT-SENSITIVE persists only Basics and Hours form fields, never payout, PAN, or bank data
